home.title: Axion-IA
home.subtitle: Operational AI consultancy
home.description: On-site AI sessions, audits and implementation for companies.
home.heroDescription: We come to your company to show you what AI can concretely do for you: diagnostic, live demos on your real data, costed action plan. Your teams leave with concrete tools to apply from day one.
home.valueEyebrow: Three services to transform your company
home.valueDescription: Concrete, delivered fast. Each time you leave with ready-to-use tools — to gain time, margins, workforce, revenue.
home.value1Bullet1: Each participant leaves with AI tools installed on their workstation, ready to use the very next morning.
home.value1Bullet2: Live demos on your real documents, real cases, real tasks — no generic scenarios.
home.value1Bullet3: Tailored to roles: sales (lead qualification, emails), managers (auto meeting minutes), operations (invoices, quotes, support)…
home.value1Gain: Each person accompanied saves 1 to 3 hours per day from week one.
home.value2Bullet1: We map every department — where AI can lower your costs, grow your sales, accelerate your operations.
home.value2Bullet2: Each opportunity costed individually: deployment cost vs expected 12-month annual gain.
home.value2Bullet3: Full audit (whole company) or focused (one department: sales, HR, support, operations, finance).
home.value2Gain: You know exactly where to find €50k, €200k or €1M per year depending on your size.
home.value3Bullet1: 24/7 customer chatbot, AI customer support, automatic invoice processing, presentation generation, sales enablement, business automations.
home.value3Bullet2: Built for your company: your business, your data, your processes — not an off-the-shelf generic tool.
home.value3Bullet3: From the artisan automating prospecting to the mid-market firm deploying an AI agent on 200 workstations — same approach.
home.value3Gain: Concrete in production within 4 to 8 weeks, support included to fine-tune with your teams.
home.valueWhy1: Concrete from day one: we work on your real data immediately, not a theoretical POC.
home.valueWhy2: For every size: artisan, micro, SME, mid-market, large group — the method scales to your reach.
home.valueWhy3: Your data stays in Europe: Hetzner Frankfurt hosting, strict GDPR, never resold.
home.valueWhy4: End-to-end personalised service: you talk to the senior consultant who delivers, not a sales rep.
home.modulesDescription: Three entry points to integrate AI in your company — no risk, no commitment, at your own pace.
home.module1Description: One day on site with your team: diagnostic, AI demos, costed action plan. From {price}.
home.module2Description: Complete mapping of your AI opportunities, per-use-case costing, prioritised action plan. {priceRange}.
home.module3Description: Production deployment: chatbot, agents, RAG, automations, custom AI. From {price}.
home.metric1Label: To map every AI opportunity in your company
home.metric2Label: Of your data stays in Europe
home.metric4Label: Saved per day, per person accompanied
home.methodDescription: No engagement without a demo on your data. No costing without mapping. No deployment without support.
home.method1Description: Free discovery call to qualify your need and pick the right module.
home.method2Description: 1-day session, 5-day audit or 4-week prototype depending on the chosen module.
home.method3Description: Prioritised PDF deliverable: estimated ROI, complexity, deployment sequence.
home.method4Description: Implementation, user testing, go-live, 30-day support included.
home.casesDescription: Five real cases documented with context, problem, solution and post-delivery figures.
home.roiDescription: Four sliders, instant 12-month calculation. No personal data input required.
home.faqDescription: The five questions our consultants get during scoping calls.
home.ctaBlockDescription: One day on site, three quick-wins identified, costed action plan. No AI prerequisite.
home.heroProofLine: 140+ companies supported · 4.9/5 satisfaction · Results in 90 days
home.manifestoLine: No 80-page report. No 3-year roadmap. AI running in your tools, by next week.
home.manifestoContext: Axion-IA is an operational AI consultancy based in France, supporting micro, small and mid-market companies in their AI transformation.
home.value4Bullet1: One-on-one sessions with a founder, manager or entrepreneur — no full room, no shared jargon.
home.value4Bullet2: Real cases, your actual documents, your real decisions to automate or sharpen with AI.
home.value4Bullet3: Flexible format: a single 2-hour session, a 3-session series, or 6-month monthly support.
home.value4Gain: You grow AI-autonomous and make faster decisions — no consultant dependency.
home.value5Bullet1: Marketing sites, e-commerce and business apps designed from day one with AI baked in — not a classic site with a chatbot glued on.
home.value5Bullet2: Strict 2026 Web Vitals, native SEO/AEO, EU GDPR-compliant hosting.
home.value5Bullet3: Perfect for rebuilding an obsolete site or launching a platform with real AI differentiation.
home.value5Gain: You get a site that converts 2 to 3x better than generic ones, indexed by AI engines.
home.logosCaption: Some of the companies that asked Axion-IA to intervene, audit or implement.
home.audienceDescription: From the solo artisan to the listed group, the method scales — formats, prices, deliverables.
home.audience1Lead: Immediate automation, founder's personal time saved.
home.audience1Detail: You run everything alone or with a tiny team. AI frees you 1 to 3 hours per day on repetitive tasks (mail, quotes, prospecting).
home.audience2Lead: Measurable ROI, team training, first strategic use cases.
home.audience2Detail: You have sales, support, operations. We identify the 3 processes that cost you the most, and we automate them.
home.audience3Lead: Department-by-department transformation, change management, AI governance.
home.audience3Detail: Several departments to coordinate. We structure a coherent AI program department by department, with impact measurement.
home.audience4Lead: Enterprise AI audit, training at scale, governance and compliance.
home.audience4Detail: IT, GDPR, AI Act, multi-site deployment. We come in as a complement to your internal teams, never a competitor.
home.audienceSectorsLead: If your company has repetitive processes, AI can optimise them. Sector by sector, case by case.
home.comparisonDescription: Many companies hesitate between several options to bring in AI: a freelancer, a big consultancy, training alone, or a SaaS. Here is what concretely sets us apart.
home.videosDescription: Three testimonials, three company sizes, three industries.
